reading.objective: Announce issue 07 of an independent architecture journal, themed on unbuilt work, with a poster that works as an editorial object.
reading.audience: Architects, students and critics who read independent writing on the built environment.
reading.feeling: Experimental and editorial: precise, drafted, slightly unsettled.

concept.idea: A plinth is the base that waits for something to stand on it, so the poster is a black plinth carrying the title, with the building above it drawn only as a dashed ghost whose roof has lifted off in solid vermilion: the unbuilt.
decisions: read first: the huge PLINTH slab at the bottom, then the vermilion roof plane floating above the ghost tower
type: heavy Archivo Black for the plinth-weight title, Space Grotesk small and exact for subhead and details, like drawing annotations
colour: concrete grey ground, near-black ink, one vermilion accent used only on the unbuilt part and the brand
composition: the lower third is a full-bleed black mass, the upper two thirds is mostly air with one tall ghost volume offset from centre and a measuring ruler at the left edge
forms: dashed construction outline, a faint hatch inside the ghost, dashed lift lines connecting the roof to its missing position, a tick ruler for scale
